name: El Jefe's Taqueria (Boston Common)
notes: Official site lists this location 8am-2am daily. Other Boston locations run to 3am. Prices not on page; burrito shop.

name: South Street Diner
notes: Official site says all-night dining 7 nights a week and 24/7 online ordering. Menu is image/PDF only.

name: The Greatest Bar
notes: Official hours; may change with TD Garden events. Saturday opening time looks like a typo on site; closing 2am.

name: Franklin Cafe
notes: Official site: open daily 5pm-2am, kitchen until 1:30am; Sunday brunch 11am-3pm.

name: Black Seed Halal Grill
notes: No official site found. Sources conflict: Downtown Boston Alliance listing says Sun-Thu 7am-11pm, Fri-Sat 7am-2:30am; Boston.com 2024 and a 2026 ranking list 2-4am. Listed in 2026 open-late ranking at restaurantsforkings.com/rankings/boston/open-late/2026/. Verify hours.

name: Double Chin
notes: No official site found. Boston.com (Oct 2024) and a 2026 open-late ranking (restaurantsforkings.com) list kitchen until 4am Fri-Sat; one directory shows 11:59pm weekends, so verify. Dumplings about $9.

name: Jade Garden
notes: No official site found. Boston.com 2024 lists 3am daily; Sluurpy and Autoreserve listings show 11am-3am. No closure news found. Verify by phone (617-423-3288).

name: Ali Baba Turkish Restaurant
notes: No official site found. Zabihah listing (photos dated Nov 2025, not marked closed) gives Mon/Tue/Sun 11am-11pm, Wed-Sat 11am-3am; Boston.com 2024 says 3am daily. Phone 617-482-0654.

name: Alexandria Pizza
stop: Silver Line Washington St (Union Park St/E Berkeley); Tufts Medical Center (Orange) about 0.5 mi
notes: No official site found. Zabihah: 11:30am-2am daily, not marked closed (photos Nov 2025); Boston.com 2024: 3am; Slice shows open to 2:50am. Also listed as Alex Pizza & Grill. Verify.

name: Anchovies
notes: Official site (anchoviesboston.com) was unreachable. Boston.com 2024 and a 2026 open-late ranking (restaurantsforkings.com) list kitchen until 1:30am daily. No reservations. Verify.

name: Lucky's Lounge
notes: Time Out lists Mon-Fri 11:30am-2am, Sat-Sun 10am-2am; Lyons Group page (via search result, fetch failed) lists Mon-Sat 4pm-2am, Sun closed. Both agree on 2am. Live music Wed-Sat. Verify Sunday.

name: Borrachito Taqueria & Spirits
notes: Official site hours (food: Mon-Wed 11am-12am, Thu-Sat 11am-1:30am, Sun 11am-12am). Seaport, a bit of a walk from the nearest Silver Line stop.

name: Chicken and Rice Guys
notes: Official site lists the 280 Washington St location (also 85 Bedford St, 17 Drydock Ave). Hours 11am-9pm daily per Time Out (official page lacks hours). About $10-11 plate. Halal status varies by listing; confirm if needed.

name: Yankee Lobster Co.
stop: South Station (Red/Silver Line), about 0.7 mi; Courthouse (Silver Line)
notes: Official hours: Mon-Sat 11am-8pm, Sun 11am-7pm. Working-waterfront spot; lobster rolls run pricey, chowder and fried seafood cheaper.

name: Mike's City Diner
notes: Hours 7am-2pm daily, closed Thanksgiving and Christmas (per official site via search summary; menu page did not list hours). Cash only per some sources.

name: The Salty Pig
notes: Official hours 11:30am-10pm Sun-Thu, 11:30am-10:30pm Fri-Sat (some third-party listings say later). Menu is on the home page.

name: Anna's Taqueria (Cambridge St)
notes: Time Out lists 7am-11pm daily. Official site (annas.com) loads but its location page did not show hours; address and hours come from Time Out. Verify hours.

name: Charlie's Sandwich Shoppe
notes: Official hours: Sun 7am-3pm, Mon-Wed 7am-2pm, Thu-Sat 7am-10pm (dinner Thu-Sat 4-10pm). Known for turkey hash.

name: Boston Public Market
notes: Official: Sun-Tue 8am-6pm, Wed-Sat 8am-8pm; vendor hours vary. Vendors include Bon Me, Mo'Rockin Fusion, Beantown Pastrami, Mr. Tamole. Mix of cheap and mid-price.

name: Sam LaGrassa's
notes: Official site: dining Mon-Fri 11am-2pm; phone orders from 7am. Menu PDF dated May 2026 confirms it is current.

name: Faneuil Hall Marketplace (Quincy Market food hall)
notes: Official hours cover whole marketplace: Mon-Sat 10am-9pm, Sun 11am-7pm; individual restaurants vary. Address from general knowledge, not on page. Touristy but many cheap stalls.

name: Chacarero
notes: Official site confirms 101 Arch St; Time Out lists Mon-Fri 8am-6pm. Official page hours not shown.

name: Montien Thai
notes: Official hours: Mon-Thu 11:30am-9:30pm, Fri-Sat 11:30am-10:30pm, Sun 4pm-9:30pm. Time Out shows slightly later hours; use official.
